jobs.occupation: Naval Architect – Superyachts | Relocate from Portugal to the Netherlands
jobs.description: Work on the engineering of custom-built superyachts Are you a Naval Architect or Marine Engineer based in Portugal and ready to take the next step in your international career? Xelvin is looking for a technically strong Naval Architect who wants to relocate to the Netherlands and work on high-end custom-built superyachts. In this role, you will contribute to the technical design and engineering of complex yacht projects. You will work on the translation of design concepts, client requirements and classification rules into technically feasible, safe and buildable solutions. This is a role for someone who understands ship design, structure, systems integration and the balance between aesthetics, performance, safety and manufacturability. What you will do As a Naval Architect, you will be involved in the engineering of luxury yachts from concept and basic engineering through detailed engineering and production support. Your responsibilities may include: Developing and checking technical ship design and engineering solutions. Working on hull design, general arrangements, layouts and technical integration. Supporting stability, weight control, structural design and construction-related calculations. Translating design concepts into technically feasible and buildable solutions. Preparing, reviewing and improving technical drawings, calculations and documentation. Coordinating with engineering teams, production, suppliers, classification societies and project stakeholders. Supporting the integration of systems, equipment, interiors and exterior elements into the overall yacht design. Identifying technical risks and proposing practical solutions. Ensuring that designs meet quality, safety, classification and production requirements. Supporting production teams during construction and resolving technical questions. Depending on your experience, the role can be more focused on basic engineering, detailed engineering, structural engineering, outfitting or technicalcoordination. What Xelvin offers you Relocating to another country is a big step. Xelvin supports you throughout the full process, from the first interview to your first working day in the Netherlands. We offer: A full-time job with long-term perspective in the Netherlands. A gross monthly salary between €3,800 and €5,800, depending on experience and technical background. Relocation support from Portugal to the Netherlands. Help with documentation, registration and practical relocation matters. Guidance from our housing consultant in finding accommodation. Paid holidays and holiday allowance. Pension arrangement. Training and development opportunities. Personal guidance from Xelvin during the relocation process. A career opportunity in one of the most respected yacht-building regions in the world. What you bring For the Portuguese market, we are looking for candidates with a background in naval architecture, marine engineering, shipbuilding or complex mechanical engineering. You have: A technical degree such as Licenciatura or Mestrado in Naval Architecture, Marine Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Ocean Engineering, Shipbuilding or a related field. Experience in shipbuilding, yacht building, marine engineering, offshore, naval design or complex technical engineering. Good understanding of ship design, construction principles and technical integration. Experience with 2D and/or 3D engineering software. Experience with software such as AutoCAD, Rhino, Siemens NX, SolidWorks, Inventor, Maxsurf, NAPA, ShipConstructor, Cadmatic or similar tools is relevant. Knowledge of stability, structures, weight control, hull design, outfitting or classification rules is a strong advantage. The ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications and engineering documentation. Strong problem-solving skills and a practical engineering mindset. Job description Are you an ambitious Instrumentation Technician (E&I) from South Africa who is ready to build an international career in the Netherlands? You will join a highly skilled maintenance team where safety, quality and continuous improvement are key priorities. This position is based in Geleen, one of the largest industrial and petrochemical hubs in the Netherlands. Your responsibilities Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on instrumentation and electrical systems. Calibrate pressure, temperature, flow and level transmitters. Troubleshoot electrical and instrumentation faults. Install and commission new field instrumentation. Read and interpret P&IDs, loop drawings and electrical schematics. Assist during plant shutdowns and turnarounds. Ensure all work complies with safety regulations and quality standards. Contribute to improving plant reliability and equipment performance. You can expect: A salary between €3,800 and €4,700 gross per month Full-time employment with long-term career opportunities Overtime and shift allowances where applicable 25 vacation days plus holiday allowance Pension scheme Extensive training and development opportunities Personal guidance throughout your career Complete relocation support Moving to another country is a big step. That's why Xelvin supports you throughout the entire relocation process. Our relocation package includes: Work visa and residence permit support Assistance with finding suitable accommodation Flight to the Netherlands Airport pick-up Municipal registration (BSN)Opening a Dutch bank account Health insurance guidance Dutch language lessons Ongoing support from your dedicated Xelvin Consultant Job requirements We are looking for motivated professionals who are ready to take the next step in their international career. Experience within the Oil & Gas, Petrochemical or Chemical industry. Knowledge of process instrumentation, control valves and field devices. Experience reading P&IDs and electrical drawings. Good English communication skills. Afrikaans language skills (preferred). A proactive attitude and willingness to relocate to the Netherlands. Preferably between 23 and 28 years old, making this an excellent opportunity for early-career professionals looking to build an international career. About the organisation Xelvin has over 20 years of experience in connecting technical professionals with leading companies throughout the Netherlands. Every year we help engineers and technicians from South Africa relocate successfully to the Netherlands, where they build long-term careers with international employers. Xelvin provides comprehensive relocation assistance, from immigration support to housing and settling into Dutch life. Our client operates in one of Europe's largest petrochemical clusters and is committed to innovation, safety and sustainability. You will work with modern technologies in an international environment where technical expertise is highly valued.
